hypothesis: At approximately route12/B16 payload bytes, eight exact IQ1_S route-slab records plus nine additional records whose gate/up matrices use Hy4-style STQ1_0 and whose down matrix remains IQ1_S reduce local routed-output error versus sixteen exact IQ1_S records on held-out captured states.

frozen_inputs.selection_rule: twelve validation rows starting at ordinal 73 with stride 149; chosen from capture metadata before measuring these rows

frozen_comparison.stq: Hy4 three-iteration weighted-LS STQ1_0 without imatrix term, emulated from dequantized IQ1_S source; fp16 block scale

gate.GO_TO_TERMINAL: candidate mean and median local relative L2 are each no worse than control, candidate wins at least 7 of 12 individual rows, and candidate bytes are no more than 1.01 times control
gate.RETAIN_LOW_PRIORITY: candidate mean local relative L2 is no worse than control and candidate bytes are no more than 1.01 times control, but a robustness condition fails
gate.NO_GO: candidate mean local relative L2 is worse than control or candidate bytes exceed 1.01 times control
gate.stop_rule: Do not tune STQ iterations, scale, sparsity, exact-core size, tail size, row set, or selector from this result. A failure closes IQ1_S-derived STQ1_0 as the leading complement candidate.

limitations: This is a held-out local captured-state discriminator, not terminal KL.
The STQ emulator requantizes already lossy IQ1_S source weights; it does not test native-precision STQ calibration.
No STQ file, HIP kernel, physical direct-read path, model behavior, decode throughput, or prefill throughput is measured.
